notes.title: The House of Da Vinci is going VR!
notes.content:
Good morning people!

Today is a good day for an announcement. The announcement I am going to make is very exciting for us and I hope it will also be very exciting at least for some of you.
We have been secretly working on an amazing adventure from the world of The House of Da Vinci and it will come out later this year for virtual reality headsets. Some of you asked for this, and some of you didn’t, but it is coming either way. What am I even talking about?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31280850/1e6f3b23a7ac629a1781e9fdfad1c5fd6844aacf.png[/img]

Are you hungry for more information? The Steam page is live and you can head there to learn more about the game and Wishlist it to be among the first to play it as soon as it comes out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948310

Not sure, why are you continuing to read this instead of going to The House of Da Vinci VR Steam page, but let me reiterate: Yes, we are making a virtual reality game. Yes, it’s gonna be amazing. Yes, all the puzzles and environments were completely redone to use the potential of VR. Yes, you can Wishlist it right now and play it in several months!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31280850/8b46d3955704fce6e5c32b5b06c6dd7044cc910a.png[/img]

notes.title: First look at our new game - House of Tesla!
notes.content:
We are working hard on the next Blue Brain Games title, House of Tesla. This time, we wish to focus a bit more on the Steam version and plan to release it on PC first and other platforms later.

You can expect everything you came to love in our games, impressive visuals, mind-bending puzzles, and an interesting story to make it all come together in a full and pleasant experience.

👉 Check the Steam page of the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738230/The_House_of_Tesla/]right here right now[/url]!

Watch the teaser, browse the screenshots, and maybe read a bit about the game.
If you wishlist now, you can follow our monthly updates to see exclusive sneak peeks into our development process and the new art that comes into life under our artists' hands. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31280850/88c74462d91c8fe1b904b9b951e2510e567e7638.gif[/img]

notes.title: Controller support for House of Da Vinci III
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We just released an update bringing game controller support to our game (you can check the controls and tweak the settings by selecting “Options” -> “Controller settings” in-game). Those of you with Steam Deck can also enjoy improved compatibility and play the game using either the controller or touchscreen. 

[b]Patch notes[/b]
- added full controller support
- changed video format for Steam Deck compatibility
- fixed characters missing from Japanese localization in the diary

notes.title: New update is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Thank you all for playing our game and sending us your feedback in the comments section and on our email. We just released an update which addresses various (mostly minor) bugs and adds two new localizations.

[b]New languages[/b]
The House of Da Vinci III now supports Ukrainian and Russian languages. You can find them in the game Options. 

[b]Various bugfixes[/b]
- Some players had bug causing their main menu no longer appearing after a crash. -> The game should now check for corrupted files and offer a backup from earlier save. If the problem is not solved for you, please contacts us on davinci@bluebraingames.com.
- fixed a missing page in the diary from chapter 8
- fixed a number of small graphical errors and glitches
- edited several hints for better clarity

notes.title: Trading cards for The House of Da Vinci III are here!
notes.content:
Our programmers are hard at work ironing out the few bugs which popped out here and there while our 3d artists are doing some final polishing (you can expect an update soon-ish).
In the meantime, the monastics (concept artists) in our scriptoriums (offices) did their best to create awesome illuminations. Unlike what you might expect from illuminations they are not part of some grand chronicle of olden times, but instead, they are presented as a much newer medium – the Steam trading cards. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001513/1069cfdd3c91493c442c3c978699acc3d40ca6b3.png[/img]

P.S. This might be a sign that we are also adding trading cards to our previous games in the near future. But that’s just a rumor.
